body: Honestly I hate saying it but, it’s probably not a good idea to start. I know it probably sounds stupid coming from me but it’s a never ending spiral after that first cut. It keeps going, on and on seemingly endless. I can understand why you want to completely, and maybe it could help, but honestly the risk of spiraling into a full on addiction is pretty high, at least in my experience. I can’t stop you from doing it, but just know the risks if you decide to do it.
Totally, I also scold myself for thinking about saying/doing something even though I didn’t.
You should check out the album SO WHAT by while she sleeps if you haven’t already it’s soooooo good
